scan.semantic_summary: Independent project-local design package for an AI-native commercial self-media account and original male digital IP. Concept V1 is rejected. V2 is now focused on constructing the Human Core—face morphology first, body as plausibility/silhouette/motion support, then hair architecture, skin/grooming and neutral performance—before wardrobe, motif, canon presentation or Presentation Modes. It is not an active continuity task and must not mutate Pilot 002 state or gates.

current_state: H0 reference decomposition has begun. The certificate portrait is the primary structural face source but not a skin/style target. The two full-body photos are supporting references for tall-slim plausibility, limb/posture/skin truth and later movement/garment constraints; they are not primary likeness sources and must not force literal body replication.
next_action: Extract a neutral face-morphology sheet from the certificate portrait first. Use the life and graduation photos only to define body plausibility boundaries and cross-check skin/posture/limb tendencies. Then compare 4–5 face primary-mass systems and 4 base-body archetypes before cyan hair, pixel accessories or wardrobe are reintroduced.
